faq.subtitle: Everything wey you need to know about PPPlayer.

items.a: Yes. PPPlayer dey completely free. No subscription, no in-app purchases, and no hidden charges.

items.q: I fit use PPPlayer for Windows?
items.a: Yes. PPPlayer dey for Windows 10 and newer versions. Just download am directly. You no need any app store.

PPPlayer fit help you discover artists, find related artists, listen to artist radio and playlists, and explore different kinds of music. E also get fine full-screen player. All the features dey free, and you no need account.

items.q: How I go take download PPPlayer?
items.a: You can download PPPlayer directly from our website for macOS, Linux, and Windows. Mobile versions are coming soon.​
No. PPPlayer dey completely free. You fit use all the features without paying or opening account.
PPPlayer supports almost all audio and video formats, including MP3, FLAC, MP4, MKV, and AVI. It also supports network streams and M3U/M3U8 playlists.​

items.q: Are there any special setup requirements for video?​
items.a: On Windows, macOS, Android, and iOS, PPPlayer works out of the box. On Linux, you may need to install standard media libraries (like libmpv) depending on your distribution.​

faq.openSourceAnswer: Yes. PPPlayer na open-source software under the MIT license. You fit use, study, change, and share the software as the license allow. Visit our GitHub repository to see the source code or contribute.

s1.title: 1. Wetin This Policy Cover
s1.p: PPPlayer ("we", "our", "the app") dey committed to protecting your privacy. This policy explain the data wey we dey collect, why we dey collect am, and how we dey use am when you use PPPlayer for macOS, Linux, Windows, iOS, or Android.

s2.title: 2. You No Need Account
s2.p: You no need to open account to use PPPlayer. We no dey collect your name, email address, or any personal information before you fit use the app.

s3.title: 3. Data Wey We Dey Collect
s3.p1: We fit collect these types of anonymous data wey no dey identify you:
s3.li1: Crash reports and error logs (to help us make the app work better)
s3.li2: Anonymous usage analytics (how you dey use features and how long you dey use the app)
s3.li3: The kind of device you dey use and its operating system version
s3.p2: We no dey collect names, email addresses, payment information, or data wey show your exact location.

s4.title: 4. Services from Other Providers
s4.p: PPPlayer fit use services from other providers for music data and analytics. These services get their own privacy policies. We advise you to read those policies.

s5.title: 5. How Long We Dey Keep Data
s5.p: We no dey keep anonymous analytics data for more than 12 months. We dey delete crash logs after 90 days.

s6.title: 6. Your Rights​
s6.p: Since we no dey collect personal data, no personal information dey for you to access, export, or delete. If you get questions, contact us through the address below.

s7.title: 7. Children​
s7.p: PPPlayer no be for children wey never reach 13 years. We no dey knowingly collect data from children.

s8.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
s8.p: We fit update this policy anytime. We go put the date of the latest update for the top of this page.

s9.title: 9. Contact​
s9.p: You get questions about this policy? Contact us for

s1.title: 1. Agreement to These Terms
s1.p: When you download or use PPPlayer, e mean say you agree to these Terms of Service. If you no agree, no use the app.

s2.title: 2. How You Fit Use the App
s2.p: PPPlayer na free, open-source software. The MIT license for the project repository explain how you fit use, copy, change, and share the software. When you use the app, you agree say you no go:
s2.li1: Remove copyright or permission notices wey the software licenses require
s2.li2: Use the app to spread malware or harmful content
s2.li3: Break any law or regulation while you dey use the app

s3.title: 3. You No Need Account
s3.p: You no need to open account to use PPPlayer. Once you download the app, you fit start to use all the features.

s4.title: 4. Intellectual Property​
s4.p: PPPlayer source code dey available under the MIT license. Third-party dependencies get their own licenses. Music, artwork, and metadata still belong to their owners. The software license no give you rights to that content.

s5.title: 5. Disclaimer of Warranties​
s5.p: We dey provide PPPlayer "as is", without any warranty, whether express or implied. We no promise say the service go always work or say the app no go get errors.

s6.title: 6. Limitation of Liability​
s6.p: To the extent wey the law allow, PPPlayer no go dey liable for any indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages wey happen because you use the app or you no fit use am.

s7.title: 7. Changes to Terms​
s7.p: We fit update these terms anytime. If you continue to use the app after we change the terms, e mean say you agree to the new terms.

s8.title: 8. Contact​
s8.p: You get questions about these terms? Contact us for

v2_0_0.desc: A massive major update transforming PPPlayer into a full media player with video and network streaming support.​
v2_0_0.videoDesc: Complete local video library and playback support featuring video controls and automatic thumbnail generation.​
v2_0_0.streamDesc: Native support for network streams with M3U playlist parsing and direct URL resolution.​
v2_0_0.subtitleDesc: Comprehensive subtitle support including customization, delay adjustment, and an intuitive selection UI.​
v2_0_0.speedDesc: Added flexible playback speed controls and an easy-access autoplay toggle directly in the queue view.​
v2_0_0.exportDesc: Seamlessly export your custom playlists and playback queues to your local device.​
v2_0_0.languagesDesc: Added official Turkish and Guarani localizations, as well as support for local genre browsing.​
v2_0_0.stabilityDesc: Overhauled the core playback engine architecture for improved stability, custom HTTP headers, and strict timeout handling.​

v1_3_6.desc: Official Android release for Google Play Store.
v1_3_6.androidDesc: Initial test release for Android devices. Support for mobile devices is actively being developed.​

v1_3_5.desc: Library screen beta levels and fixing for speed.
v1_3_5.libraryDesc: We do better things for the library screen and fix how cards dey respond.

v1_3_4.desc: Picture-in-Picture support, native splash screens, and other beta things.
v1_3_4.pipDesc: Add support so you can watch video while doing other things and beta navigation.
v1_3_4.splashDesc: Add better open screens and app icons for Android, iOS, and Web.
v1_3_4.uiDesc: Fix how the small player dey stay so e go perfectly stay for the right side of the screen.

v1_3_3.desc: Automatic builds and how work flow.
v1_3_3.ciDesc: Add GitHub Actions make e dey build am automatically for all platform.

v1_3_2.desc: System media controls sync and main things.
v1_3_2.syncDesc: Bring MediaSyncService to make the play status balance with your device controls, even for Windows.
v1_3_2.libraryDesc: Add how you fit filter, sort, and search your music for library screen.

v1_3_1.desc: Achieved 100% translation parity and fixed UI bugs.​
v1_3_1.syncDesc: Synchronized translation keys and applied manually curated translations across all 30 languages.​
v1_3_1.uiDesc: Resolved widget const errors in the Home and Library screens, and fixed GitHub repository links in the About dialog.​

v1_3_0.desc: This release brings PPPlayer to an even wider global audience.​
v1_3_0.localizationDesc: Added localizations for Nigerian Pidgin, Filipino, Latvian, Bengali, Croatian, Malay, Persian, and Estonian.​

v1_2_0.desc: We don add support for 10 more languages.
v1_2_0.lang10Desc: We don add full support for Indonesian, Burmese, Polish, Danish, Kazakh, Czech, Hungarian, Georgian, Swedish, and Uzbek.

v1_1_2.desc: We don add Arabic and Chinese translations and fix bugs wey dey happen when you resize the macOS app window.
v1_1_2.localizationDesc: We don add translations for Arabic and Chinese (Simplified and Traditional).
v1_1_2.layoutDesc: We don fix the issue wey dey make the YouTube video player shift away from the centre when you resize the app window for macOS.

v1_1_1.desc: We don fix playback bugs and improve how the seek bar dey work when you open the app.
v1_1_1.snapTitle: Seek Bar Bug When App Start
v1_1_1.snapDesc: We don fix the issue wey dey make the seek bar jump back to the beginning if you drag am just after you open the app.
v1_1_1.durationTitle: Song Duration Wey No Dey Show
v1_1_1.durationDesc: We don fix the issue wey dey make the seek bar show 0:00 as the song duration when you first open the app.

v1_1_0.desc: The whole app and website now get support for different languages.
v1_1_0.langDesc: We don add full support for Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Hindi, Russian, and Arabic.
v1_1_0.pickerDesc: We don add language picker for the Preferences menu. When you choose a language, the translations go show straight away. You no need to restart the app.
v1_1_0.osDesc: For Android 13+ and iOS, the app fit automatically follow the language wey you choose for am in your device settings.

v1_0_6.desc: Quick fix for people wey just install the app.
v1_0_6.crashTitle: Fix for Crash When App Start
v1_0_6.crashDesc: We don fix serious bug wey dey make newly installed apps crash with blank screen because one environment configuration file no dey.

v1_0_5.desc: Music fit continue to play smoothly for background on macOS.
v1_0_5.appNapDesc: We don stop macOS App Nap from suspending the player when you minimise the app, so the songs for your queue fit continue to play.

v1_0_4.desc: App releases and code signing now dey run automatically.
v1_0_4.ciDesc: We don add GitHub Actions workflow to build the app consistently and sign the macOS releases.
v1_0_4.signedDesc: Official macOS releases wey we don sign and notarize now dey available directly from the website.
v1_0_4.licenseDesc: We don add MIT License to the repository.
v1_0_4.submoduleFix: We don fix the submodule checkout settings for the CI workflows.

v1_0_3.desc: Better background playback and app stability.
v1_0_3.hybridEngineDesc: The playback engine fit handle background tasks and keep music playing when your screen dey locked.
v1_0_3.dedupDesc: We don add generation IDs to stop media commands from overlapping and prevent old commands from running through the WebView bridge.
v1_0_3.queueAdvance: We don fix the issue wey dey stop the queue from moving to the next song automatically.
v1_0_3.resumeBug: We don fix the issue wey dey make paused songs start to play again when playback move from the main app view to PiP or background.
v1_0_3.precision: The player now dey report the current song position and playback duration accurately, down to milliseconds.
v1_0_3.linter: We don fix several IDE linter errors and remove files wey we no need.

v1_0_2.desc: Smarter autoplay wey follow wetin you dey listen to.
v1_0_2.autoplayContextTitle: Autoplay Wey Follow Your Listening Context
v1_0_2.autoplayContextDesc: Autoplay now dey choose songs from the current artist first before e add songs from related artists to the queue.
v1_0_2.tieredRecsDesc: The recommendation system now dey use the selected artist's catalogue directly, instead of searching for names wey just look similar.

v1_0_1.desc: Better experience when you dey listen to music.
v1_0_1.autoplayDesc: Music go continue with song suggestions based on wetin you dey listen to.
v1_0_1.discoverDesc: Find music based on wetin you don listen to before, your favourite artists, and your playlists.
v1_0_1.tooltipsTitle: Hints Wey Follow the Seek Bar
v1_0_1.tooltipsDesc: We don add tooltips wey follow your mouse pointer when you move am over the player progress bar.
v1_0_1.startup: The app now dey open faster.
v1_0_1.recovery: Playback now dey recover better when something go wrong.
v1_0_1.macosMedia: We don improve the media controls for macOS.
v1_0_1.duplicateMedia: We don fix the duplicate media controls for macOS.
v1_0_1.stationHighlight: The song wey dey play for a station now dey highlighted.
v1_0_1.seekbarPause: We don fix the issue wey dey make playback pause or stop unexpectedly when you drag the seek bar.
v1_0_1.bottomBar: We don fix the issue wey dey make the bottom player bar transparent and hard to read when music dey play for macOS.

v1_0_0.desc: The first version of PPPlayer don land.
v1_0_0.playlists: Playlists, favourites, and history of wetin you don listen to
v1_0_0.platforms: Support for macOS, Windows, and Linux

v2_0_1.desc: A maintenance and feature release bringing new languages, quick playback actions, and improved UI designs.​
v2_0_1.languagesDesc: Added support for Dutch, Romanian, Thai, Ukrainian, Urdu, and Vietnamese.​
v2_0_1.quickPlayDesc: Added direct top tracks playback on artist cards, and direct playlist/album playback on hover overlays.​
v2_0_1.socialsDesc: Added Instagram, Facebook, and LinkedIn links to the about dialog.​
v2_0_1.uiDesc: Redesigned genre and search category cards with dynamic hash-based colors and icons.​
v2_0_1.cleanupDesc: Routine maintenance and removal of temporary debugging and development scripts from the repository to reduce clutter.​
